cues.en: Now in the previous lecture we have learned what is recursion.
In this video let's look at why do we need recursion?
First of all, recursive thinking is really important in programming and it helps you break down big
problems into smaller ones and easier to use.
So as we saw in the previous lecture, whenever we are opening the gift box, we are making this big
problem smaller and smaller than finding the solution.
And in programming also, whenever we are facing the big problems, we have to break them into smaller
ones and solve them.
So the recursion can help us to solve the big problems by making them smaller and smaller.
And often recursive solution can be simpler to read than the iterative one, so recursion is used all
the time in nearly in every language.
So if you compare the recursive way of writing the code with the iterative way, you can easily see
that the recursive way is easy to write once you understand this.
So that's why recursion is preferable.
Now, the second reason is that recursion is used in many data structures like trees and graphs.
So when we are dealing with trees, the recursion becomes almost mandatory to use.
So in our upcoming section we will explain the tree data structure.
And there you will see that without recursion, some operations on trees becomes almost impossible.
But it does not mean that we cannot use iteration over there.
But in case of recursion, it's preferable due to the easier nature to write the code.
So without learning the recursion, upcoming section will be extremely difficult to understand.
Now, the third reason is that many big companies ask questions related to recursion during the interview.
So to pass these interviews, we need to get better at recursion.
So this is very important especially for fun questions.
So to be able to solve that questions you have to practice more on recursion.
Now the last reason is that recursion is used in many algorithms.
So I'm not going to go to the details of that algorithms over here.
We are going to see them in our upcoming sessions as well.
So these are the reasons that you need to learn the recursion for becoming a better programmer, or
to get a better job in top tech companies.
